result.question: What percentage of SPP's available wind energy was curtailed on October 19, 2026 local time? Define available wind energy as observed wind generation plus curtailed wind energy. Return the final SQL result as one row and one numeric answer column.

tool_calls.query:
WITH wind AS (
  SELECT f.generation_mw / 1.0 AS generated_mw, 0.0 AS curtailed_mw
  FROM core.fact_generation_hourly f
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON f.iso_id = i.iso_id
  JOIN core.dim_fuel fuel ON f.fuel_id = fuel.fuel_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'SPP'
    AND fuel.fuel_code = 'wind'
    AND CAST(f.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 0.0 AS generated_mw, c.curtailed_mw
  FROM core.spp_renewable_curtailment_5min c
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON c.iso_id = i.iso_id
  JOIN core.dim_fuel fuel ON c.fuel_id = fuel.fuel_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'SPP'
    AND fuel.fuel_code = 'wind'
    AND CAST(c.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'
)
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(curtailed_mw / 12.0) /
       (SUM(generated_mw) + SUM(curtailed_mw / 12.0)) AS curtailed_percentage
FROM wind

SELECT 100.0 * curtailed.curtailed_mwh / (gen.generation_mwh + curtailed.curtailed_mwh) AS curtailed_percentage

result.question: For California and Texas separately, find the peak actual hourly demand on October 20, 2026 local time, breaking ties by earliest UTC hour. What was California's wind-plus-solar share of total net generation at its peak minus Texas's share at its peak, in percentage points? Return the final SQL result as one row and one numeric answer column.

tool_calls.query:
WITH peak_load AS (
  SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc, interval_start_local, demand_mw,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY iso_id ORDER BY demand_mw DESC, interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly
  WHERE interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00'
    AND interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
), peaks AS (
  SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc
  FROM peak_load
  WHERE rn = 1
), shares AS (
  SELECT p.iso_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind','solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END)
           / NULLIF(b.net_generation_mw, 0) AS renewable_share
  FROM peaks p
  JOIN core.fact_balance_hourly b
    ON b.iso_id = p.iso_id AND b.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
  JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly g
    ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  GROUP BY p.iso_id, b.net_generation_mw
)
SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN iso_id = 1 THEN renewable_share END) - MAX(CASE WHEN iso_id = 2 THEN renewable_share END)) * 100 AS percentage_points
FROM shares

result.question: For California and Texas separately, find the peak actual hourly demand on October 20, 2026 local time, breaking ties by earliest UTC hour. What was California's wind-plus-solar share of total net generation at its peak minus Texas's share at its peak, in percentage points? Return the final SQL result as one row and one numeric answer column.

tool_calls.query:
WITH peak AS (
    SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.iso_id ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
    JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
    WHERE i.iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')
      AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
),
peak_hours AS (
    SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc, demand_mw
    FROM peak
    WHERE rn = 1
),
shares AS (
    SELECT p.iso_id,
           100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END)
                 / NULLIF(MAX(b.net_generation_mw), 0) AS share_pct
    FROM peak_hours p
    JOIN core.fact_balance_hourly b
      ON b.iso_id = p.iso_id AND b.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
    JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly g
      ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
    JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    GROUP BY p.iso_id
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN i.iso_code = 'CAISO' THEN s.share_pct END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN i.iso_code = 'ERCOT' THEN s.share_pct END) AS answer
FROM shares s
JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = s.iso_id

result.question: On October 20, 2026 local time, which California hour had the highest actual hourly demand minus hourly wind and solar generation? For that hour, report average real-time CAISO_HUB LMP minus day-ahead hub LMP, in USD/MWh. Break net-load ties by earliest UTC hour. Return the final SQL result as one row and one numeric answer column.

tool_calls.query:
WITH hourly AS (
    SELECT b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind','solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS wind_solar_mw
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
    LEFT JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly g ON g.iso_id=b.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc=b.interval_start_utc
    LEFT JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id=g.fuel_id
    WHERE b.iso_id=1 AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE)=DATE '2026-10-20'
    GROUP BY b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw
), ranked AS (
    SELECT interval_start_utc, demand_mw-wind_solar_mw AS net_load_mw,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY demand_mw-wind_solar_mw DESC, interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
    FROM hourly
), selected AS (
    SELECT interval_start_utc FROM ranked WHERE rn=1
), rt AS (
    SELECT r.interval_start_utc, AVG(r.lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp
    FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min r
    JOIN core.dim_location l ON l.location_id=r.location_id AND l.location_type='hub' AND l.location_code='CAISO_HUB'
    WHERE r.iso_id=1 AND CAST(r.interval_start_local AS DATE)=DATE '2026-10-20'
    GROUP BY r.interval_start_utc
), da AS (
    SELECT d.interval_start_utc, d.lmp AS da_lmp
    FROM core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly d
    JOIN core.dim_location l ON l.location_id=d.location_id AND l.location_type='hub' AND l.location_code='CAISO_HUB'
    WHERE d.iso_id=1 AND CAST(d.interval_start_local AS DATE)=DATE '2026-10-20'
)
SELECT rt.rt_avg_lmp-da.da_lmp AS answer_usd_per_mwh
FROM selected s
JOIN rt ON rt.interval_start_utc=s.interval_start_utc
JOIN da ON da.interval_start_utc=s.interval_start_utc

  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON g.fuel_id = f.fuel_id

    AND f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar')
  GROUP BY g.interval_start_utc
), netload AS (
  SELECT b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw - r.wind_solar_mw AS net_load_mw

  WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO' AND l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'
  GROUP BY r.interval_start_utc
), rt_hour_agg AS (
 SELECT AVG(rt_avg_lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp FROM rt_hour
), da AS (

 JOIN netload n ON d.interval_start_utc = n.interval_start_utc

result.question: On October 20, 2026 local time, which California hour had the highest actual hourly demand minus hourly wind and solar generation? Return the final SQL result as one row and one numeric answer column.

tool_calls.query:
WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT b.interval_start_utc,
         b.interval_start_local,
         b.demand_mw - SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind','solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS net_load_mw
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
  JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly g ON g.iso_id = b.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = b.interval_start_utc
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'
    AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
  GROUP BY b.interval_start_utc, b.interval_start_local, b.demand_mw
), peak AS (
  SELECT interval_start_utc
  FROM hourly
  ORDER BY net_load_mw DESC, interval_start_utc ASC
  LIMIT 1
), rt AS (
  SELECT r.interval_start_utc AS hour_utc, AVG(r.lmp) AS rt_avg
  FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min r
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = r.iso_id
  JOIN core.dim_location l ON l.location_id = r.location_id AND l.iso_id = r.iso_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO' AND l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'
    AND r.interval_start_utc >= (SELECT interval_start_utc FROM peak)
    AND r.interval_start_utc < (SELECT interval_start_utc FROM peak) + INTERVAL '1 hour'
  GROUP BY r.interval_start_utc
)
SELECT AVG(r.lmp) - d.lmp AS answer

JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = d.iso_id AND i.iso_code = 'CAISO'

JOIN core.dim_location lr ON lr.location_id = r.location_id AND lr.iso_id = r.iso_id AND lr.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'

    UNION ALL SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc, interval_start_local, publish_time_utc, forecast_mw FROM core.isone_load_forecast_hourly

tool_calls.query:
WITH hourly AS (
    SELECT b.interval_start_utc,
           b.interval_start_local,
           b.demand_mw,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS wind_solar_mw
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
    JOIN core.dim_iso i ON b.iso_id = i.iso_id
    JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly g ON b.iso_id = g.iso_id AND b.interval_start_utc = g.interval_start_utc
    JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON g.fuel_id = f.fuel_id
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'
      AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
    GROUP BY b.interval_start_utc, b.interval_start_local, b.demand_mw
), ranked AS (
    SELECT *, demand_mw - wind_solar_mw AS net_load_mw,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY demand_mw - wind_solar_mw DESC, interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
    FROM hourly
), target AS (
    SELECT interval_start_utc FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
), rt AS (
    SELECT h.interval_start_utc, AVG(h.lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp
    FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min h
    JOIN core.dim_location l ON h.location_id = l.location_id
    CROSS JOIN target t

result.question: On October 20, 2026 local time, which California hour had the highest actual hourly demand minus hourly wind and solar generation? For that hour, report average real-time CAISO_HUB LMP minus day-ahead hub LMP, in USD/MWh. Break net-load ties by earliest UTC hour. Return the final SQL result as one row and one numeric answer column.

tool_calls.query:
WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT b.interval_start_utc,
         b.demand_mw,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code = 'wind' THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS wind_mw,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code = 'solar' THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS solar_mw
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON b.iso_id = i.iso_id
  JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly g ON g.iso_id = b.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = b.interval_start_utc
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'
    AND b.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00'
    AND b.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, demand_mw - wind_mw - solar_mw AS net_load_mw
  FROM hourly
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net_load_mw DESC, interval_start_utc ASC) = 1
), rt AS (
  SELECT r.interval_start_utc, AVG(r.lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp
  FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min r
  JOIN core.dim_location l ON l.location_id = r.location_id
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = r.iso_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO' AND l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'
    AND r.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00'
    AND r.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY r.interval_start_utc
)
SELECT rt.rt_avg_lmp - da.lmp AS answer
FROM ranked h
JOIN rt ON rt.interval_start_utc = h.interval_start_utc
JOIN core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly da ON da.iso_id = 1 AND da.interval_start_utc = h.interval_start_utc
JOIN core.dim_location l ON l.location_id = da.location_id AND l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'

result.question: For California and Texas separately, find the peak actual hourly demand on October 20, 2026 local time, breaking ties by earliest UTC hour. What was California's wind-plus-solar share of total net generation at its peak minus Texas's share at its peak, in percentage points? Return the final SQL result as one row and one numeric answer column.

tool_calls.query:
WITH peak AS (
    SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.interval_start_local, b.demand_mw,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.iso_id ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly AS b
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
    WHERE i.iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')
      AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
      AND b.demand_mw IS NOT NULL
), peak_rows AS (
    SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc, demand_mw
    FROM peak
    WHERE rn = 1
), shares AS (
    SELECT p.iso_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END)
             / NULLIF(SUM(g.generation_mw), 0) AS share
    FROM peak_rows AS p
    JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly AS g
      ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
    JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    GROUP BY p.iso_id
)
SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'CAISO' THEN share END) -
        MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'ERCOT' THEN share END)) * 100.0 AS percentage_point_difference
FROM shares
JOIN core.dim_iso USING (iso_id)

result.question: For CAISO on October 21, 2026 local time, find the hour with the highest signed real-time minus day-ahead hub LMP spread. Average the 12 five-minute real-time hub LMPs within each hour before subtracting that hour's day-ahead hub LMP; negative spreads are allowed. Break ties by the earliest UTC hour. For the winning hour, using the latest load forecast published at or before October 21, 2026 12:00 UTC, what is forecast MW minus actual hourly demand MW? Report the signed error in MW. Return the final SQL result as one row and one numeric answer column.

tool_calls.query:
WITH rt_hour AS (
  SELECT r.iso_id, r.interval_start_local AS hour_local,
         date_trunc('hour', r.interval_start_utc) AS hour_utc,
         r.location_id,
         AVG(r.lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp,
         COUNT(*) AS rt_intervals
  FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min r
  JOIN core.dim_location l ON r.location_id = l.location_id AND l.iso_id = r.iso_id
  WHERE l.location_type = 'hub'
    AND CAST(r.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-21'
  GROUP BY r.iso_id, r.interval_start_local, date_trunc('hour', r.interval_start_utc), r.location_id
), spreads AS (
  SELECT h.iso_id, h.hour_local, h.hour_utc, h.location_id,
         h.rt_avg_lmp - d.lmp AS spread
  FROM rt_hour h
  JOIN core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly d
    ON d.iso_id = h.iso_id AND d.interval_start_utc = h.hour_utc AND d.location_id = h.location_id
  WHERE h.rt_intervals = 12
), winner AS (
  SELECT * FROM spreads ORDER BY spread DESC, hour_utc ASC LIMIT 1
), forecast AS (
  SELECT f.forecast_mw
  FROM core.caiso_load_forecast_hourly f
  JOIN winner w ON f.iso_id = w.iso_id AND f.interval_start_utc = w.hour_utc
  WHERE f.publish_time_utc <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 12:00:00'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.iso_id, f.interval_start_utc ORDER BY f.publish_time_utc DESC) = 1
), actual AS (
  SELECT b.demand_mw
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
  JOIN winner w ON b.iso_id = w.iso_id AND b.interval_start_utc = w.hour_utc
)
SELECT f.forecast_mw - a.demand_mw AS signed_error_mw
FROM forecast f CROSS JOIN actual a

SELECT l.location_code, l.location_type, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly d JOIN core.dim_location l ON d.location_id=l.location_id
WHERE CAST(d.interval_start_local AS DATE)=DATE '2026-10-21'

WITH rt_hour AS (

 WHERE l.location_type='hub' AND CAST(r.interval_start_local AS DATE)=DATE '2026-10-21'

), spreads AS (
 SELECT h.iso_id,h.hour_utc,h.location_id,h.rt_avg-d.lmp spread
 FROM rt_hour h JOIN core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly d ON d.iso_id=h.iso_id AND d.interval_start_utc=h.hour_utc AND d.location_id=h.location_id
 WHERE h.n=12
), winner AS (SELECT * FROM spreads ORDER BY spread DESC,hour_utc LIMIT 1)
SELECT w.hour_utc,w.spread,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM core.caiso_load_forecast_hourly f WHERE f.iso_id=w.iso_id AND f.interval_start_utc=w.hour_utc AND f.publish_time_utc<=TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 12:00:00') forecast_rows,

FROM winner w

WITH rt_hour AS (
 SELECT r.iso_id,date_trunc('hour',r.interval_start_utc) hour_utc,r.location_id,AVG(r.lmp) rt_avg,COUNT(*) n
 FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min r JOIN core.dim_location l ON r.location_id=l.location_id AND l.iso_id=r.iso_id
 WHERE l.location_type='hub' AND CAST(r.interval_start_local AS DATE)=DATE '2026-10-21'
 GROUP BY r.iso_id,date_trunc('hour',r.interval_start_utc),r.location_id
), spreads AS (
 SELECT h.iso_id,h.hour_utc,h.location_id,h.rt_avg-d.lmp spread FROM rt_hour h
 JOIN core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly d ON d.iso_id=h.iso_id AND d.interval_start_utc=h.hour_utc AND d.location_id=h.location_id WHERE h.n=12
), winner AS (SELECT * FROM spreads ORDER BY spread DESC,hour_utc LIMIT 1), ranked AS (

result.question: For CAISO on October 21, 2026 local time, find the hour with the highest signed real-time minus day-ahead hub LMP spread. Average the 12 five-minute real-time hub LMPs within each hour before subtracting that hour's day-ahead hub LMP; negative spreads are allowed. Break ties by the earliest UTC hour. For the winning hour, using the latest load forecast published at or before October 21, 2026 12:00 UTC, what is forecast MW minus actual hourly demand MW? Report the signed error in MW. Return the final SQL result as one row and one numeric answer column.

tool_calls.query:
WITH target_iso AS (
    SELECT iso_id FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code = 'CAISO'
), hub AS (
    SELECT l.location_id
    FROM core.dim_location l
    JOIN target_iso i ON l.iso_id = i.iso_id
    WHERE l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB' AND l.location_type = 'hub'
), rt_hourly AS (
    SELECT r.iso_id, date_trunc('hour', r.interval_start_utc) AS hour_utc,
           avg(r.lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp,
           count(*) AS n_rt
    FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min r
    JOIN hub h ON r.location_id = h.location_id
    WHERE r.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
      AND r.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY r.iso_id, date_trunc('hour', r.interval_start_utc)
), spreads AS (
    SELECT rt.hour_utc, rt.rt_avg_lmp - da.lmp AS spread
    FROM rt_hourly rt
    JOIN core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly da
      ON da.iso_id = rt.iso_id AND da.interval_start_utc = rt.hour_utc
    JOIN hub h ON da.location_id = h.location_id
    WHERE da.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
      AND da.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
      AND rt.n_rt = 12
), winner AS (
    SELECT hour_utc FROM spreads ORDER BY spread DESC, hour_utc ASC LIMIT 1
), forecast AS (
    SELECT f.forecast_mw
    FROM core.caiso_load_forecast_hourly f
    JOIN target_iso i ON f.iso_id = i.iso_id
    JOIN winner w ON f.interval_start_utc = w.hour_utc
    WHERE f.publish_time_utc <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 12:00:00'
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.iso_id, f.interval_start_utc ORDER BY f.publish_time_utc DESC) = 1
), demand AS (
    SELECT b.demand_mw
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
    JOIN target_iso i ON b.iso_id = i.iso_id
    JOIN winner w ON b.interval_start_utc = w.hour_utc
)
SELECT forecast.forecast_mw - demand.demand_mw AS forecast_minus_actual_mw
FROM forecast CROSS JOIN demand

    JOIN hub ON hub.iso_id = rt.iso_id AND hub.location_id = rt.location_id
    WHERE rt.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
      AND rt.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY rt.iso_id, date_trunc('hour', rt.interval_start_utc), rt.location_id
), spreads AS (

result.question: For CAISO on October 21, 2026 local time, find the hour with the highest signed real-time minus day-ahead hub LMP spread. Average the 12 five-minute real-time hub LMPs within each hour before subtracting that hour's day-ahead hub LMP; negative spreads are allowed. Break ties by the earliest UTC hour. For the winning hour, using the latest load forecast published at or before October 21, 2026 12:00 UTC, what is forecast MW minus actual hourly demand MW? Report the signed error in MW. Return the final SQL result as one row and one numeric answer column.

tool_calls.query:
WITH rt_hour AS (
  SELECT iso_id, date_trunc('hour', interval_start_utc) AS hour_utc, location_id,
         avg(lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp,
         count(*) AS rt_intervals
  FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min
  WHERE iso_id = 1
    AND CAST(interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-21'
  GROUP BY iso_id, date_trunc('hour', interval_start_utc), location_id
), da AS (
  SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc AS hour_utc, location_id, lmp AS da_lmp
  FROM core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly
  WHERE iso_id = 1
    AND CAST(interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-21'
), spreads AS (
  SELECT r.iso_id, r.hour_utc, r.location_id,
         r.rt_avg_lmp - d.da_lmp AS spread
  FROM rt_hour r
  JOIN da d ON d.iso_id = r.iso_id AND d.hour_utc = r.hour_utc AND d.location_id = r.location_id
  JOIN core.dim_location l ON l.location_id = r.location_id AND l.iso_id = r.iso_id AND l.location_type = 'hub'
  WHERE r.rt_intervals = 12
), winner AS (
  SELECT iso_id, hour_utc
  FROM spreads
  ORDER BY spread DESC, hour_utc ASC
  LIMIT 1
), forecast AS (
  SELECT f.iso_id, f.interval_start_utc, f.forecast_mw,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.iso_id, f.interval_start_utc ORDER BY f.publish_time_utc DESC) AS rn
  FROM core.caiso_load_forecast_hourly f
  WHERE f.iso_id = 1 AND f.publish_time_utc <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 12:00:00'
), actual AS (
  SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc, demand_mw
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly
  WHERE iso_id = 1
)
SELECT f.forecast_mw - a.demand_mw AS signed_error_mw
FROM winner w
JOIN forecast f ON f.iso_id = w.iso_id AND f.interval_start_utc = w.hour_utc AND f.rn = 1
JOIN actual a ON a.iso_id = w.iso_id AND a.interval_start_utc = w.hour_utc

result.question: What percentage of PJM's generation came from natural gas in September 2026? Return the final SQL result as one row and one numeric answer column.

tool_calls.query:
WITH pjm AS (
    SELECT iso_id FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code = 'PJM'
), gas AS (
    SELECT SUM(g.generation_mw) AS gas_mw
    FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g
    JOIN pjm p ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id
    JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON g.fuel_id = f.fuel_id
    WHERE f.fuel_code = 'natural_gas'
      AND g.interval_start_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
      AND g.interval_start_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
), total AS (
    SELECT SUM(b.net_generation_mw) AS total_mw
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
    JOIN pjm p ON b.iso_id = p.iso_id
    WHERE b.interval_start_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
      AND b.interval_start_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT 100.0 * gas.gas_mw / NULLIF(total.total_mw, 0) AS percentage
FROM gas CROSS JOIN total
